title: The story adds DECLINED_BY_APPROVER_SET to the closed list LOV-CASE-STATUS
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Reference Data and Lists of Values v5.xlsx (Lists, Values)
section: §12.8 Contract fakes; §4 Flow; §7 Acceptance criteria; §9 State transitions
description: RWB-P3-E2013-APP adds the value DECLINED_BY_APPROVER_SET to LOV-CASE-STATUS as data. proposed: Rule whether the criterion stays (and the list becomes open, with the yaml enum removed) or the criterion uses an existing value. Needs a ruling; no edit until then.

proposed: Rule whether the criterion stays (and the list becomes open, with the yaml enum removed) or the criterion uses an existing value. Needs a ruling; no edit until then.

title: The story adds SUBROGATION_POSITION to the closed list LOV-CLAIM-STATUS
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Reference Data and Lists of Values v5.xlsx (Lists, Values)
section: §1 Story; §12.8 Contract fakes; §13 Solution plan; §2 Business rationale; §7 Acceptance criteria; §8 Business rules; §9 State transitions
description: RWB-S3-E4018-APP adds the value SUBROGATION_POSITION to LOV-CLAIM-STATUS as data. LOV-CLAIM-STATUS is a 'Closed list' in Reference Data v5 (Lists), with the values DEFECT, FILED, PAID, PREPARING, REJECTED; a closed list gains a value only by a change of the list, and any service that holds the list as an enum must change too.

B) Reference Data v5, Lists, LOV-CLAIM-STATUS: Kind 'Closed list'; Values: DEFECT, FILED, PAID, PREPARING, REJECTED.
proposed: Rule whether the criterion stays (and the list becomes open, with the yaml enum removed) or the criterion uses an existing value. Needs a ruling; no edit until then.

section: §1 Story; §12.2 REST operations consumed; §12.8 Contract fakes; §15 Screens and states; §2 Business rationale; §4 Flow; §7 Acceptance criteria; §8 Business rules; §9 State transitions
description: RWB-S4-E5013-APP adds the value LITIGATION_HELD to LOV-LEGAL-STATUS as data. LOV-LEGAL-STATUS is a 'Closed list' in Reference Data v5 (Lists), with the values CLOSED, ENFORCING, FILED, JUDGMENT, OPEN, WITHDRAWN; a closed list gains a value only by a change of the list, and any service that holds the list as an enum must change too.
evidence: A) RWB-S4-E5013-APP line 63: 'The last change is the one the legacy wording makes explicit: **"hold the litigation rather than withdraw it."** `LOV-LEGAL-STATUS` has no held value, and no source gives a hold column, so the hold is'. proposed: Rule whether the criterion stays (and the list becomes open, with the yaml enum removed) or the criterion uses an existing value. Needs a ruling; no edit until then.

description: RWB-S5-E3024-APP adds the value ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON to LOV-HOLDING as data. B) Reference Data v5, Lists, LOV-HOLDING: Kind 'Closed list'; Values: HELD, LISTED, RENTED, SOLD, TRANSFERRED, UNDER_OFFER.
proposed: Rule whether the criterion stays (and the list becomes open, with the yaml enum removed) or the criterion uses an existing value. Needs a ruling; no edit until then.

title: The story adds DATA_ROOM_OPEN to the closed list LOV-LOT-STATUS
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Reference Data and Lists of Values v5.xlsx (Lists, Values)
section: §12.8 Contract fakes; §16 Test cases; §7 Acceptance criteria; §8 Business rules; §9 State transitions
description: RWB-S6-E6003-APP adds the value DATA_ROOM_OPEN to LOV-LOT-STATUS as data. LOV-LOT-STATUS is a 'Closed list' in Reference Data v5 (Lists), with the values AWARDED, BUILDING, CLOSED, OFFERED, TRANSFERRED; a closed list gains a value only by a change of the list, and any service that holds the list as an enum must change too.

B) Reference Data v5, Lists, LOV-LOT-STATUS: Kind 'Closed list'; Values: AWARDED, BUILDING, CLOSED, OFFERED, TRANSFERRED.
proposed: Rule whether the criterion stays (and the list becomes open, with the yaml enum removed) or the criterion uses an existing value. Needs a ruling; no edit until then.
